elsa_cs: Quick note from Wildflower onboarding — midday spike (p95 ~2.8s, 500-800 tokens). Theyre on rwd-orion-7b-8k fp16. Renewal flagged if UX not improved.

ben_se: Propose 4% canary with rwd-orion-7b-6k-int8 + time-of-day routing for 11:30-13:00 local. Also enable prefix KV caching and reduce batching to 10ms for canary.

rui_ml: Agree. Run a 120-prompt fidelity set (customer-provided). int8 expected: ~25-35% cost down, p95 to ~1.2s. Add automated semantic-similarity check + 20 manual spot checks.

margo_pm: Can we have a one-paragraph customer blurb by EOD? They want expected p95, cost delta, rollback steps.

ben_se: Sample route config (Console API):
```
name: wildflower-quant-canary
canary: 0.04
models:
  - id: rwd-orion-7b-6k-int8
    weight: 0.04
  - id: rwd-orion-7b-8k
    weight: 0.96
time_window:
  start: "11:30"
  end: "13:00"
batching_ms: 10
prefix_cache: true
```

rui_ml: Rollback triggers: human-eval pass rate < 0.95 on 120-set OR p95 increases vs baseline OR any spike in hallucination rate >0.5%. Also exclude flows marked sensitive.

elsa_cs: Action items: ben -> push canary + runbook; rui -> eval by noon; margo -> blurb. ci-bot: preview deploy?

ci-bot: Preview created: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/preview/wildflower-6379990000 (canary started at 6379990250). Logs: https://console.redwood.ai/logs/canary/6379990250

elsa_cs: I'll update Wildflower after 2h observation window. :thumbsup:
